summary: Crash when setting LodestonePos of compass to something other than NBT compound
description: The bug The game crashes when changing or creating a compass item with a LodestonePos having a value other than an NBT compound tag. [^(20w17a) crash-2020-04-23_21.44.55-server.txt] Description: Ticking player java.lang.ClassCastException: lp cannot be cast to la at bhr.a(SourceFile:144) at bje.a(SourceFile:454) at bcw.j(SourceFile:290) at bcx.l(SourceFile:575) at anz.h(SourceFile:2217) at bcx.h(SourceFile:274) at ys.i(SourceFile:411) at zj.b(SourceFile:199) at ma.a(SourceFile:234) at zi.c(SourceFile:171) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:839) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:766) at enn.a(SourceFile:89) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.run(SourceFile:625) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745) How to reproduce Do this in a test world /give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"} The game freezes and you will see in the log file that it has crashed
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Open the chat window.
4. Enter the command: `/give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}`.
5. Press Enter to execute the command.
6. Wait for the game to freeze.
7. Observe that the game crashes and check the log file for the crash report.
Observed Behavior:
When attempting to create or modify a compass item in Minecraft with the `LodestonePos` property set to a value that is not a valid NBT compound tag, the game encounters a `ClassCastException` and crashes. Specifically, if the `LodestonePos` is set to a string or any other non-NBT compound format, the game fails to cast the provided value to the expected NBT type, resulting in an error during the player tick event.

Upon executing the command:
```
/give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}
```
the game freezes and subsequently crashes, generating a crash report that indicates the issue stemmed from an invalid type being used for the `LodestonePos`. The crash log contains the following relevant stack trace:
```
java.lang.ClassCastException: lp cannot be cast to la
at bhr.a(SourceFile:144)
at bje.a(SourceFile:454)
...
```
This behavior highlights that the game expects `LodestonePos` to be defined in a proper NBT compound format, such as `{X:0,Y:0,Z:0}`, and any deviation from this format results in a critical failure, disrupting gameplay and requiring a restart of the server or client. 

Developers should ensure that input validation is implemented for NBT tags to prevent such crashes when invalid data types are assigned.
Expected Behavior: When a player attempts to create or modify a compass item with a valid LodestonePos value formatted as an NBT compound tag, the game should successfully update the compass without any crashes or errors. The compass should reflect the new LodestonePos accurately, allowing players to utilize the compass functionality as intended. This behavior should occur consistently across all game modes and versions without causing any instability.
